scope: 42 bounded editorial/source/provenance checks across seven guides; not a full independent fact-check or human acceptance.
source_method: Official webpages and one government-hosted historical PDF inspected this turn; image provenance checked against existing canonical records and selected local hashes. No fresh fieldwork, outreach, image generation or rights permission obtained.

checks.check: Bhubaneswar — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: Official overview supports the modern city’s attribution to Otto Königsberger and the guide’s heritage framing. Coastal edition removes the painted-street promise while retaining the original full draft.

checks.check: Bhubaneswar — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: The city/landscape bridge and invitation to slow down are labelled editorial framing; no new quotation, eyewitness conversation or religious miracle is introduced.

checks.check: Bhubaneswar — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: The official climate passage supports November–March as seasonal guidance and June–September rain. Transport prompts make no fare, duration or step-free guarantee.

checks.check: Bhubaneswar — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: Dhauli is the available inner-page stop; the shared collection continues to Konark. Meal and base research remain reachable at the collection ending. Excluded standalone cards are absent.

checks.check: Bhubaneswar — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: Mukteswar and Dhauli photographs retain their dated captions and source/creator/licence records. Six regional source-image hashes were rechecked; no claim of fresh field photography or new rights clearance.

checks.check: Bhubaneswar — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Step-free routes, toilets, named hosts, current opening details and fluent Odia proofreading remain open. The absence of those checks is recorded, not marked resolved.

checks.check: Dhauli — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: The official Dhauligiri account supports the 1972 stupa and the two construction organizations. The modern monument remains distinct from Ashokan evidence.

checks.check: Dhauli — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: The red-river story remains explicitly a legend. The page does not adopt the tourism source’s unsupported battle superlatives or turn the narrative into measured evidence.

checks.check: Dhauli — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: Access questions cover steps, shade, toilets and return transport. The advertised sound-and-light programme is expressly unconfirmed; no live show schedule is supplied.

checks.check: Dhauli — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: Bhubaneswar context and the next Konark chapter remain connected. The stupa and rock-cut elephant images help separate historical layers rather than imply one construction date.

checks.check: Dhauli — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: Bernard Gagnon’s stupa photo and AmlanTheTramp’s elephant photo retain separate attribution and licences. Source-file hashes match their existing records.

checks.check: Dhauli — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Current venue rules, accessibility, transport arrangements and any show programme still require local confirmation. No historical quotation was newly reproduced.

checks.check: Konark — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: UNESCO supports the thirteenth-century temple, Surya-chariot conception and sculptural importance. Its short overview and fuller description differ on the horse count; this review does not add or resolve that count.

checks.check: Konark — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: Dharmapada remains a literary/legend connection rather than construction evidence. No new poem excerpt or cinematic-location claim is introduced; original-edition and language review remain open.

checks.check: Konark — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: Regional October–February advice is supported by Incredible India. An older festival page remains cultural context, not a 2026 booking calendar; opening hours, fees and transfers are unverified.

checks.check: Konark — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: Inline sculpture, shore and dance ideas stay readable despite excluded standalone routes. Coastal meal anchors and the shared base comparison resolve within this edition.

checks.check: Konark — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: The temple, Chandrabhaga, sweet and Odissi images retain their source trail. The stage photograph is explicitly New Delhi, not a photographed Konark festival. No image was regenerated or relabelled as field evidence.

checks.check: Konark — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Current festival confirmation, original Dharmapada text, detailed accessibility and inspected operators remain research gaps. Passing software checks does not clear these editorial questions.

checks.check: Puri — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: The official city guide connects Jagannath traditions, the beach and Raghurajpur. The page does not infer unrestricted temple access from the attraction listing.

checks.check: Puri — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: Devotional meaning is described in context. Invitations to speak with makers are original editorial suggestions, not invented testimony or a promise that someone will host a visitor.

checks.check: Puri — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: The beach source advises consulting Nulia lifeguards; current warnings still govern. Seasonal advice is attributed to Incredible India, without treating its promotional swimming language as a guarantee.

checks.check: Puri — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: Raghurajpur, Mahaprasad and the coastal base comparison remain connected. The collection gives the shore and craft different moments rather than a timed circuit.

checks.check: Puri — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: The beach image is dated 2011, credited to Aleksandr Zykov and labelled as context. The artisan photo does not invent a personal identity. Regional image hashes remain consistent.

checks.check: Puri — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Temple eligibility, festival traffic, current beach conditions, accommodation and local transport remain to be confirmed. No current availability or access endorsement is added.

checks.check: Raghurajpur — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: The tourism account supports cloth painting, Jagannath themes and the dance connection. The December 2005 historical account attributes a revival narrative to Ileana Citaristi and places Halina Zealey’s involvement around 1953; that qualified attribution remains.

checks.check: Raghurajpur — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: Mythology is the subject of the art, not proof that depicted events occurred. Workshop questions and buying advice are labelled editorial guidance; a 2019 visitor account remains dated testimony.

checks.check: Raghurajpur — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: No current household count, guaranteed workshop opening or free demonstration is stated. The page asks about access, facilities and permission rather than assuming them.

checks.check: Raghurajpur — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: The last chapter leads to personal planning, a coastal meal and a base. Ask-about-materials and maker-credit prompts offer useful local interaction without treating residents as performers.

checks.check: Raghurajpur — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: The 2018 artisan image retains the source’s unnamed subject; the 2008 landscape is not described as a workshop. Both local files match recorded hashes and preserve their reuse records.

checks.check: Raghurajpur — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Artist identification, fresh invited local testimony, workshop arrangements and physical accessibility remain open. The historical revival account is not represented as a complete independent history.

checks.check: Coastal food — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: Official sources support Mahaprasad’s Jagannath context and the regional fish-in-mustard, prawn curry and cheese-sweet leads. They do not prove Konark origin or daily restaurant availability.

checks.check: Coastal food — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: Temple-offering identity stays separate from restaurant dining. Tourism descriptions of miraculous cooking and broad health benefits are not adopted as culinary facts.

checks.check: Coastal food — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: The page asks about ingredients, preparation and current availability. It does not certify allergen safety, kitchen quality, prices or a dietary guarantee.

checks.check: Coastal food — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: All four dish anchors work in the scoped catalogue, including the stable chhena-poda ID. The excluded standalone sweet article is not promised by the coastal edition.

checks.check: Coastal food — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: The Puri chhena-poda photo is explicitly a dish illustration, not Mahaprasad or a reviewed restaurant. Creator, licence and source are retained in the guide and book data.

checks.check: Coastal food — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Named kitchens, firsthand menu checks, prices and culinary/local-language review remain future work. Readers are given questions to ask, not invented recommendations.

checks.check: Coastal stay areas — Trace history or food/place identity claims to existing sources
checks.finding: Puri’s setting is supported by its official guide; Incredible India supports the Ramachandi river/sea setting. The comparison remains Utkal editorial planning guidance.

checks.check: Coastal stay areas — Separate local belief and editorial invitation from verified fact
checks.finding: No property rating, testimonial, endorsement or paid relationship is implied. The quieter-base language explicitly needs confirmation and is not treated as an objective guarantee.

checks.check: Coastal stay areas — Check access, season and transport guidance for unsupported certainty
checks.finding: The comparison asks for actual addresses, routes, room access, noise, full prices and cancellation terms. It supplies no live inventory or verified transfer times.

checks.check: Coastal stay areas — Check food/stay/experience connections remain useful and in scope
checks.finding: Three settings use the same fit/transport/check fields; coastal food and the personal plan remain reachable. Individual excluded stay pages do not remain as broken links.

checks.check: Coastal stay areas — Check photograph context, creator, licence and reuse record
checks.finding: The Puri beach photograph is labelled as a 2011 coastal context image, not a room view. Its hash, creator and licence record are preserved.

checks.check: Coastal stay areas — Record unresolved local, language or rights questions honestly
checks.finding: Property inspections, room-category evidence, accessible bathrooms, service reliability and return transport remain unverified. No booking or commercial commitment is created.
